QUOTE: "`_bindings.py` is generated by `scripts/gen_bindings.py` from the header and marked "do not edit". A pre-commit check fails if it drifts."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a pre-commit check fails when the generated bindings drift from the header. It doesn't say the check re-runs the generator and diffs, but that is the implied mechanism, so I'm treating the item as stated.
